text:
Alex P: handing off — quick summary before I log off in 30m. short incident this evening where model-router pods started returning 503s for ~20m due to a memory leak in the kv-cache eviction path. page noise started at ~1977768200, mitigations applied, system stabilized.

Mira Chen: thanks Alex. can you list what you changed and where? any customer impact we should flag to CS?

Alex P: yeah — steps:
- scaled model-router pool from 12 -> 24 replicas to absorb inflight requests
- temporarily disabled aggressive prefix caching (set PREFETCH=false) to stop cache thrashing
- applied a hotfix to the eviction loop (deployed as canary to 2 replicas)
- restarted the oldest 4 router pods to reclaim leaked memory

We saw 503 spike to ~18% for affected region (us-west-2) from 20:12–20:32 UTC. CS notified with an initial blurb. No orders lost, just failed generation attempts that were retried by clients.

oncall-bot: Incident 197777-hot-kv-leak created. Severity: P2. Pages sent to @oncall.

Samir R: any relevant logs or runbook pointers?

Alex P: logs: `router_eviction: mem_before=7.8GB mem_after=9.4GB leak_detected=true` repeated. Relevant runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/model-router-memory.md (look at section 4: cache eviction tuning). Quick cmds I used:
```
# scale pool
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/model-router --replicas=24
# toggle prefetch
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/model-router PREFETCH=false
# restart oldest pods
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/model-router --to-revision=$(kubectl -n inference get rs | tail -n 4 | awk '{print $1}')
```

Mira Chen: good. did the canary hotfix show any regressions?

Alex P: canary ran ~12m, no increased error rate, latency actually dropped by ~50ms on canary nodes. rolled to 50% for a short window, then full rollout.

Jordan L: customer impact — which customers hit it hardest?

Alex P: we saw higher volume from 3 customers on dedicated capacity (team-lex, docs-gen, marketing-ai). the Dedicated fallback policy kicked in for lex and docs-gen after failures; marketing-ai saw a few retries. CS assigned a ticket for post-mortem to reach out.

Samir R: coverage gap check — who's primary/secondary after handoff?

Alex P: primary: Mira Chen (today evening/night), secondary: Jordan L. I'm on-call shadow til 2030 UTC and then I'm out.

Mira Chen: acknowledged. any outstanding actions I should pick up?

Alex P: short list: 
1) verify memory metrics on model-router for next 2 hours (Grafana dashboard: inference.router.mem)
2) bump eviction threshold in canary if signs of recurrence (runbook cmd in section 4)
3) coordinate with infra to schedule a non-urgent cluster node reboot for nodes that hit >90% mem historically (ticket #INF-4891)
4) follow up with CS on 3 affected customers and confirm retries were successful

Mira Chen: noted. I'll keep an eye for alerts and check the dashboard at +15m and +45m. Jordan, can you pick up INF-4891 tomorrow AM if it still shows refractory nodes?

Jordan L: yep, I'll follow up. also will check the canary deployment logs for any anomalies overnight.

deploy-bot: rollout/model-router to v3.2.1 completed at 1977771000.

Samir R: any long-term mitigation items to add to backlog?

Alex P: yes — we're adding:
- stronger eviction circuit-breaker (avoid continuous eviction looping)
- per-tenant cache quotas so a noisy tenant can't blow mem across routers
- better mem leak alerting (alert when router mem growth > 10% over 10m)
I'll file the tickets tomorrow: INF-4900 (eviction CB), INF-4901 (tenant cache quotas), MON-3344 (mem growth alert).

Mira Chen: sounds good. anything else from you Alex?

Alex P: just one note: we saw one flapping deploy job that coincided with spike — `ci/canary-infra` failed twice; might be unrelated but worth scanning CI logs.

Mira Chen: I'll glance through CI logs and ping infra if needed. handing over now — reaching out if anything pops. :wave:

Alex P: thanks all. leaving notes in the incident ticket and in the runbook. file links: https://internal.redwood/incidents/197777-hot-kv-leak and https://internal.redwood/runbooks/model-router-memory.md#section-4

Jordan L: thanks Alex — good handoff.

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded. Next primary: Mira Chen. Reminders set for 15m and 45m dashboard checks.

Mira Chen: closing thread for now, will re-open if we see recurrences.
